scope: Historical Chinese counterparts indexed to all 423 Pāli positions in the 26-chapter reader
editorial_policy: T210 is preferred. Actual T212 or T213 historical counterparts are used only where the selected table has no T210 counterpart, and each reading retains its exact Taishō collection reference. Missing coverage is not filled by retranslating Pāli.

sources.title: Pāli–Chinese Dhammapada correspondence tables, all 26 Pāli chapters
sources.note: Only correspondence facts and ancient verse quotations are retained; modern Pāli translations and explanatory commentary are not reproduced.

pinyin.method: pypinyin 0.55.0 citation-tone output, with manual contextual corrections for polyphonic and historical characters. Syllables are spaced character by character; word segmentation and tone sandhi are not asserted. Expanded reader: rare historical forms 𦾨, 𣧑, and 𭶑 use the readings of 孽, 凶, and 黠 given by the correspondence quotation or CBETA normalization. New syllables have received limited contextual review.
pinyin.status: editorial reading aid; not an independently reviewed historical pronunciation or translation
